title: Hangover Easy Suite/6BR/3500sqft Walk to Broadway
description:
Walk to Broadway from our 3rd floor, 3,500 sq ft suite of The Maddox Hotel. Fully loaded, including shuffleboard and foosball game tables, along with plenty of board games! The perfect place for group trips, bachelorette / bachelor parties, corporate retreats, executive getaways, business meeting or birthday celebrations. All the comforts of home but way more fun!  Every member of your group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located suite. TPAC, Bridgestone Arena, Titans S

The space
This 3,477 sq feet suite has 6 bedrooms, 3 full baths (1 of the bathrooms has 3 private shower stalls), and one 1/2 bath. We have a built-in convection/microwave oven, a refrigerator and freezer, separate ice maker, dishwasher, 2-burner induction stove top, an air fryer, crock pot, waffle maker, and toasters. You will be able to whip up the basics, and then some, in the kitchen.

Guest access
This suite is on the 3rd floor of The Maddox Hotel and you and your guests will have sole access to the bedrooms, bathrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen and game room. Your code will open the exterior building doors as well as your suite.

Other things to note
There is a downtown grocery store within walking distance or a Whole Foods and Publix, both a mile away.
